text: Your child imitates you: if you are on the phone all the time, he will want to do the same. Be the qudwah (role model)—keep the phone in a drawer during playtime, mealtime, and bedtime. Your attention to him is more precious than any app.

review_defects.why: The Arabic uses a plain, direct phrase 'كن القدوة' (be the role model) without any transliteration or parenthetical. The English introduces the transliterated Arabic word 'qudwah' and a parenthetical explanation, making the tone more formal and preachy compared to the warm, direct Arabic.
